class TinyUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
self.c1=nn.Conv2d(1,8,3,1,1)
self.c2=nn.Conv2d(8,16,3,1,1)
self.c3=nn.Conv2d(16,8,3,1,1)
self.out=nn.Conv2d(8,1,1)
def forward(self,x):
        s1=F.relu(self.c1(x))
s2=F.relu(self.c2(s1))
u=F.interpolate(s2,scale_factor=1,mode='nearest')
d=F.relu(self.c3(u))
return self.out(d)
x=torch.randn(1,1,32,32)

class WideBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,c=32,widen=2):
        super().__init__()
w=c*widen
self.c1=nn.Conv2d(c,w,3,padding=1)

self.proj=nn.Conv2d(c,w,1)

        r=F.relu(self.c1(x))
r=self.c2(r)
return F.relu(r+self.proj(x))

import torch,torch.nn as nn
class Mixer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,tokens=16,dims=32):
        super().__init__()
self.token_mlp=nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(tokens,tokens*2),nn.GELU(),nn.Linear(tokens*2,tokens))
self.channel_mlp=nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(dims,dims*2),nn.GELU(),nn.Linear(dims*2,dims))
def forward(self,x):
        y=x+self.token_mlp(x.transpose(1,2)).transpose(1,2)
z=y+self.channel_mlp(y)
return z

class MHA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,d_model=64,nhead=4):
        super().__init__()
self.nhead=nhead
self.dk=d_model//nhead
self.qkv=nn.Linear(d_model,3*d_model)
self.o=nn.Linear(d_model,d_model)
def forward(self,x):
        B,T,D=x.shape
qkv=self.qkv(x)
q,k,v=qkv.chunk(3,dim=-1)
q=q.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
k=k.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
v=v.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
scores=(q@k.transpose(-2,-1))/(self.dk**0.5)
attn=scores.softmax(dim=-1)
out=(attn@v).transpose(1,2).contiguous().view(B,T,-1)
return self.o(out),(q,k,v,attn)
def energy_per_head(T,dk,dv=None):
    dv=dk if dv is None else dv
return T*T*dk+T*T+T*dv
def prune_heads_energy(module:MHA,keep_ratio=0.5,T=64):
    with torch.no_grad():
        H=module.nhead;dk=module.dk
energy=torch.tensor([energy_per_head(T,dk)]*H,dtype=torch.float32)
W_out=module.o.weight.detach()
per_head=W_out.view(module.nhead,dk,-1).abs().mean(dim=(1,2))
score=per_head/(energy+1e-9)
k=max(1,int(keep_ratio*H))
keep=torch.topk(score,k).indices.tolist()
def mask_qkv(linear,keep,dk,H):
            W=linear.weight.data
D=dk*H
idx_keep=[]
for part in range(3):
                base=part*D
for h in keep:
                    idx_keep.extend(range(base+h*dk,base+(h+1)*dk))
linear.weight=nn.Parameter(W[idx_keep,:].clone())
linear.out_features=len(idx_keep)
if linear.bias is not None:
                b=linear.bias.data
linear.bias=nn.Parameter(b[idx_keep].clone())
mask_qkv(module.qkv,keep,dk,H)
W=module.o.weight.data
Dold=W.size(1);Dnew=dk*len(keep)
module.o.weight=nn.Parameter(W[:,:Dnew].clone())
if module.o.bias is not None:module.o.bias=nn.Parameter(module.o.bias.data.clone())
module.nhead=len(keep)

return self.fc(x)
def ho_wo(H,W,k,p,s,d):
    Ho=(H+2*p-d*(k-1)-1)//s+1
Wo=(W+2*p-d*(k-1)-1)//s+1
return Ho,Wo
def layer_energy(conv,in_shape):
    B,C,H,W=in_shape
kh,kw=conv.kernel_size;s=conv.stride[0];p=conv.padding[0];d=conv.dilation[0]
Ho,Wo=ho_wo(H,W,kh,p,s,d)
macs=Ho*Wo*conv.out_channels*(conv.in_channels//conv.groups)*kh*kw
act=Ho*Wo*conv.out_channels
return 2*macs+act
def energy_splits(layers,in_shapes,target_sparsity=0.4,keep_floor=0.2):
    E=torch.tensor([layer_energy(l,ish)for l,ish in zip(layers,in_shapes)],dtype=torch.float32)
share=E/E.sum()
keep=torch.clamp(1.0-target_sparsity*share,keep_floor,0.95).tolist()
return keep

    with torch.no_grad():
        B,C,H,W=in_shape
kh,kw=conv.kernel_size;Ho,Wo=ho_wo(H,W,kh,conv.padding[0],conv.stride[0],conv.dilation[0])
energy=Ho*Wo*conv.in_channels*kh*kw

score=l1/(energy+1e-9)

keep=torch.topk(score,k).indices

from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
class SimpleMHA(keras.layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self,d_model=64,num_heads=4):
        super().__init__()
self.d_model=d_model;self.num_heads=num_heads;self.dk=d_model//num_heads
self.qkv=layers.Dense(3*d_model);self.o=layers.Dense(d_model)
def call(self,x):
        B,T,D=tf.shape(x)[0],tf.shape(x)[1],self.d_model
qkv=self.qkv(x)
q,k,v=tf.split(qkv,3,axis=-1)
q=tf.reshape(q,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk]);k=tf.reshape(k,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk]);v=tf.reshape(v,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk])
q=tf.transpose(q,[0,2,1,3]);k=tf.transpose(k,[0,2,1,3]);v=tf.transpose(v,[0,2,1,3])
scores=tf.matmul(q,k,transpose_b=True)/tf.sqrt(tf.cast(self.dk,tf.float32))
attn=tf.nn.softmax(scores,axis=-1)
out=tf.matmul(attn,v)
out=tf.reshape(tf.transpose(out,[0,2,1,3]),[B,T,self.d_model])
return self.o(out)
def energy_per_head(T,dk):return T*T*dk+T*T+T*dk
def prune_heads_energy(layer:SimpleMHA,keep_ratio=0.5,T=64):
    Wout=layer.o.kernel
H=layer.num_heads;dk=layer.dk
energy=tf.cast(tf.ones([H])*energy_per_head(T,dk),tf.float32)
Wblocks=tf.reshape(Wout,[layer.d_model,H,dk])
imp=tf.reduce_mean(tf.abs(Wblocks),axis=[0,2])
score=imp/(energy+1e-9)
k=tf.maximum(1,tf.cast(tf.round(keep_ratio*tf.cast(H,tf.float32)),tf.int32))
keep=tf.argsort(score,direction='DESCENDING')[:k]
new_in=k*dk
Wnew=Wout[:,:new_in]
layer.o.kernel.assign(Wnew)
layer.num_heads=k.numpy()
x=tf.random.normal([2,64,64])
mha=SimpleMHA(64,4)
prune_heads_energy(mha,0.5,64)
y=mha(x);print(y.shape,'heads',mha.num_heads)

class MHA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,d_model=64,nhead=4):
        super().__init__()
self.nhead=nhead
self.dk=d_model//nhead
self.qkv=nn.Linear(d_model,3*d_model)
self.o=nn.Linear(d_model,d_model)
def forward(self,x):
        B,T,D=x.shape
qkv=self.qkv(x)
q,k,v=qkv.chunk(3,dim=-1)
q=q.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
k=k.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
v=v.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
scores=(q@k.transpose(-2,-1))/(self.dk**0.5)
attn=scores.softmax(dim=-1)
out=(attn@v).transpose(1,2).contiguous().view(B,T,-1)
return self.o(out),(q,k,v,attn)
def energy_per_head(T,dk,dv=None):
    dv=dk if dv is None else dv
return T*T*dk+T*T+T*dv
def prune_heads_energy(module:MHA,keep_ratio=0.5,T=64):
    with torch.no_grad():
        H=module.nhead;dk=module.dk
energy=torch.tensor([energy_per_head(T,dk)]*H,dtype=torch.float32)
W_out=module.o.weight.detach()
per_head=W_out.view(module.nhead,dk,-1).abs().mean(dim=(1,2))
score=per_head/(energy+1e-9)
k=max(1,int(keep_ratio*H))
keep=torch.topk(score,k).indices.tolist()
def mask_qkv(linear,keep,dk,H):
            W=linear.weight.data
D=dk*H
idx_keep=[]
for part in range(3):
                base=part*D
for h in keep:
                    idx_keep.extend(range(base+h*dk,base+(h+1)*dk))
linear.weight=nn.Parameter(W[idx_keep,:].clone())
linear.out_features=len(idx_keep)
if linear.bias is not None:
                b=linear.bias.data
linear.bias=nn.Parameter(b[idx_keep].clone())
mask_qkv(module.qkv,keep,dk,H)
W=module.o.weight.data
Dold=W.size(1);Dnew=dk*len(keep)
module.o.weight=nn.Parameter(W[:,:Dnew].clone())
if module.o.bias is not None:module.o.bias=nn.Parameter(module.o.bias.data.clone())
module.nhead=len(keep)

return self.fc(x)
def ho_wo(H,W,k,p,s,d):
    Ho=(H+2*p-d*(k-1)-1)//s+1
Wo=(W+2*p-d*(k-1)-1)//s+1
return Ho,Wo
def layer_energy(conv,in_shape):
    B,C,H,W=in_shape
kh,kw=conv.kernel_size;s=conv.stride[0];p=conv.padding[0];d=conv.dilation[0]
Ho,Wo=ho_wo(H,W,kh,p,s,d)
macs=Ho*Wo*conv.out_channels*(conv.in_channels//conv.groups)*kh*kw
act=Ho*Wo*conv.out_channels
return 2*macs+act
def energy_splits(layers,in_shapes,target_sparsity=0.4,keep_floor=0.2):
    E=torch.tensor([layer_energy(l,ish)for l,ish in zip(layers,in_shapes)],dtype=torch.float32)
share=E/E.sum()
keep=torch.clamp(1.0-target_sparsity*share,keep_floor,0.95).tolist()
return keep

    with torch.no_grad():
        B,C,H,W=in_shape
kh,kw=conv.kernel_size;Ho,Wo=ho_wo(H,W,kh,conv.padding[0],conv.stride[0],conv.dilation[0])
energy=Ho*Wo*conv.in_channels*kh*kw

score=l1/(energy+1e-9)

keep=torch.topk(score,k).indices

from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
class SimpleMHA(keras.layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self,d_model=64,num_heads=4):
        super().__init__()
self.d_model=d_model;self.num_heads=num_heads;self.dk=d_model//num_heads
self.qkv=layers.Dense(3*d_model);self.o=layers.Dense(d_model)
def call(self,x):
        B,T,D=tf.shape(x)[0],tf.shape(x)[1],self.d_model
qkv=self.qkv(x)
q,k,v=tf.split(qkv,3,axis=-1)
q=tf.reshape(q,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk]);k=tf.reshape(k,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk]);v=tf.reshape(v,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk])
q=tf.transpose(q,[0,2,1,3]);k=tf.transpose(k,[0,2,1,3]);v=tf.transpose(v,[0,2,1,3])
scores=tf.matmul(q,k,transpose_b=True)/tf.sqrt(tf.cast(self.dk,tf.float32))
attn=tf.nn.softmax(scores,axis=-1)
out=tf.matmul(attn,v)
out=tf.reshape(tf.transpose(out,[0,2,1,3]),[B,T,self.d_model])
return self.o(out)
def energy_per_head(T,dk):return T*T*dk+T*T+T*dk
def prune_heads_energy(layer:SimpleMHA,keep_ratio=0.5,T=64):
    Wout=layer.o.kernel
H=layer.num_heads;dk=layer.dk
energy=tf.cast(tf.ones([H])*energy_per_head(T,dk),tf.float32)
Wblocks=tf.reshape(Wout,[layer.d_model,H,dk])
imp=tf.reduce_mean(tf.abs(Wblocks),axis=[0,2])
score=imp/(energy+1e-9)
k=tf.maximum(1,tf.cast(tf.round(keep_ratio*tf.cast(H,tf.float32)),tf.int32))
keep=tf.argsort(score,direction='DESCENDING')[:k]
new_in=k*dk
Wnew=Wout[:,:new_in]
layer.o.kernel.assign(Wnew)
layer.num_heads=k.numpy()
x=tf.random.normal([2,64,64])
mha=SimpleMHA(64,4)
prune_heads_energy(mha,0.5,64)
y=mha(x);print(y.shape,'heads',mha.num_heads)

class MHA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,d_model=64,nhead=4):
        super().__init__()
self.nhead=nhead
self.dk=d_model//nhead
self.qkv=nn.Linear(d_model,3*d_model)
self.o=nn.Linear(d_model,d_model)
def forward(self,x):
        B,T,D=x.shape
qkv=self.qkv(x)
q,k,v=qkv.chunk(3,dim=-1)
q=q.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
k=k.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
v=v.view(B,T,self.nhead,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
scores=(q@k.transpose(-2,-1))/(self.dk**0.5)
attn=scores.softmax(dim=-1)
out=(attn@v).transpose(1,2).contiguous().view(B,T,-1)
return self.o(out),(q,k,v,attn)
def energy_per_head(T,dk,dv=None):
    dv=dk if dv is None else dv
return T*T*dk+T*T+T*dv
def prune_heads_energy(module:MHA,keep_ratio=0.5,T=64):
    with torch.no_grad():
        H=module.nhead;dk=module.dk
energy=torch.tensor([energy_per_head(T,dk)]*H,dtype=torch.float32)
W_out=module.o.weight.detach()
per_head=W_out.view(module.nhead,dk,-1).abs().mean(dim=(1,2))
score=per_head/(energy+1e-9)
k=max(1,int(keep_ratio*H))
keep=torch.topk(score,k).indices.tolist()

            W=linear.weight.data
D=dk*H
idx_keep=[]
for part in range(3):
                base=part*D
for h in keep:
                    idx_keep.extend(range(base+h*dk,base+(h+1)*dk))
linear.weight=nn.Parameter(W[idx_keep,:].clone())
linear.out_features=len(idx_keep)
if linear.bias is not None:
                b=linear.bias.data
linear.bias=nn.Parameter(b[idx_keep].clone())
mask_qkv(module.qkv,keep,dk,H)
W=module.o.weight.data
Dold=W.size(1);Dnew=dk*len(keep)
module.o.weight=nn.Parameter(W[:,:Dnew].clone())
if module.o.bias is not None:module.o.bias=nn.Parameter(module.o.bias.data.clone())
module.nhead=len(keep)

class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
self.c1=nn.Conv2d(3,16,3,padding=1)

self.c3=nn.Conv2d(32,64,3,padding=1,stride=2)
self.fc=nn.Linear(64,10)
def forward(self,x):
        x=F.relu(self.c1(x));x=F.relu(self.c2(x));x=F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(F.relu(self.c3(x)),1).view(x.size(0),-1)
return self.fc(x)
def ho_wo(H,W,k,p,s,d):
    Ho=(H+2*p-d*(k-1)-1)//s+1
Wo=(W+2*p-d*(k-1)-1)//s+1
return Ho,Wo
def layer_energy(conv,in_shape):
    B,C,H,W=in_shape
kh,kw=conv.kernel_size;s=conv.stride[0];p=conv.padding[0];d=conv.dilation[0]
Ho,Wo=ho_wo(H,W,kh,p,s,d)
macs=Ho*Wo*conv.out_channels*(conv.in_channels//conv.groups)*kh*kw
act=Ho*Wo*conv.out_channels
return 2*macs+act
def energy_splits(layers,in_shapes,target_sparsity=0.4,keep_floor=0.2):
    E=torch.tensor([layer_energy(l,ish)for l,ish in zip(layers,in_shapes)],dtype=torch.float32)
share=E/E.sum()
keep=torch.clamp(1.0-target_sparsity*share,keep_floor,0.95).tolist()
return keep
def prune_out(conv,keep_ratio,in_shape):
    with torch.no_grad():
        B,C,H,W=in_shape
kh,kw=conv.kernel_size;Ho,Wo=ho_wo(H,W,kh,conv.padding[0],conv.stride[0],conv.dilation[0])
energy=Ho*Wo*conv.in_channels*kh*kw
W=conv.weight.detach().abs()
l1=W.view(W.size(0),-1).mean(1)
score=l1/(energy+1e-9)
k=max(1,int(keep_ratio*conv.out_channels))
keep=torch.topk(score,k).indices
conv.weight=nn.Parameter(conv.weight[keep].clone())
if conv.bias is not None:conv.bias=nn.Parameter(conv.bias[keep].clone())
conv.out_channels=k
net=Net()
layers=[net.c1,net.c2,net.c3]
in_shapes=[(1,3,64,64),(1,16,64,64),(1,32,32,32)]

for l,k,ish in zip(layers,keeps,in_shapes):prune_out(l,k,ish)
x=torch.randn(2,3,64,64);print(net(x).shape,[l.out_channels for l in layers],[round(k,2)for k in keeps])

class SimpleMHA(keras.layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self,d_model=64,num_heads=4):
        super().__init__()

self.qkv=layers.Dense(3*d_model);self.o=layers.Dense(d_model)
def call(self,x):
        B,T,D=tf.shape(x)[0],tf.shape(x)[1],self.d_model
qkv=self.qkv(x)
q,k,v=tf.split(qkv,3,axis=-1)
q=tf.reshape(q,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk]);k=tf.reshape(k,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk]);v=tf.reshape(v,[B,T,self.num_heads,self.dk])
q=tf.transpose(q,[0,2,1,3]);k=tf.transpose(k,[0,2,1,3]);v=tf.transpose(v,[0,2,1,3])
scores=tf.matmul(q,k,transpose_b=True)/tf.sqrt(tf.cast(self.dk,tf.float32))
attn=tf.nn.softmax(scores,axis=-1)
out=tf.matmul(attn,v)
out=tf.reshape(tf.transpose(out,[0,2,1,3]),[B,T,self.d_model])
return self.o(out)

Wblocks=tf.reshape(Wout,[layer.d_model,H,dk])

score=imp/(energy+1e-9)
k=tf.maximum(1,tf.cast(tf.round(keep_ratio*tf.cast(H,tf.float32)),tf.int32))
keep=tf.argsort(score,direction='DESCENDING')[:k]
new_in=k*dk
Wnew=Wout[:,:new_in]
layer.o.kernel.assign(Wnew)
layer.num_heads=k.numpy()

import torch,torch.nn as nn,torch.nn.functional as F
class U(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
self.c1=nn.Conv2d(1,8,3,padding=1)
self.c2=nn.Conv2d(8,16,3,padding=1)

def forward(self,x):
        a=F.relu(self.c1(x));b=F.relu(self.c2(a))
u=F.interpolate(b,scale_factor=1,mode='nearest')
d=F.relu(self.c3(u));return self.out(d)

import jax,jax.numpy as jnp
key=jax.random.PRNGKey(0)
w=jax.random.normal(key,(10,2));b=jnp.zeros((2,))
def step(w,b,x,y,lr=1e-2):
    logits=x@w+b
probs=jax.nn.softmax(logits)
loss=-jnp.mean(jnp.log(probs[jnp.arange(y.size),y]))
grad_w=(x.T@(probs-jax.nn.one_hot(y,2)))/x.shape[0]
grad_b=jnp.mean(probs-jax.nn.one_hot(y,2),axis=0)
return w-lr*grad_w,b-lr*grad_b
for e in range(3):
    x=jax.random.normal(key,(32,10));y=jax.random.randint(key,(32,),0,2)
w,b=step(w,b,x,y)
print('done')

class RotateCKPT(keras.callbacks.Callback):
    def __init__(self,pattern='ckpt/ep_{epoch:02d}.weights.h5',keep=2):super().__init__();self.pattern=pattern;self.keep=keep
def on_epoch_end(self,epoch,logs=None):
        path=self.pattern.format(epoch=epoch+1)
self.model.save_weights(path)
hist=sorted(glob.glob('ckpt/ep_*.weights.h5'))
for f in hist[:-self.keep]:os.remove(f)

ckpt=tf.train.Checkpoint(step=tf.Variable(1),w=w,b=b,opt=opt)
manager=tf.train.CheckpointManager(ckpt,'./ckpt_tf',max_to_keep=3)
for e in range(1,7):
    x=tf.random.normal([64,10]);y=tf.random.uniform([64],maxval=2,dtype=tf.int32)
with tf.GradientTape()as tape:
        logits=tf.matmul(x,w)+b
loss=tf.reduce_mean(tf.keras.losses.sparse_categorical_crossentropy(y,logits,from_logits=True))
grads=tape.gradient(loss,[w,b]);opt.apply_gradients(zip(grads,[w,b]))
ckpt.step.assign(e);manager.save()
print('done')

net=nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(8,16),nn.ReLU(),nn.Linear(16,2))
opt=optim.SGD(net.parameters(),0.1)
best=1e9;patience,wait=2,0
os.makedirs('ckpt',exist_ok=True)
for epoch in range(1,13):
    x=torch.randn(64,8);y=torch.randint(0,2,(64,))
loss=nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(net(x),y)
opt.zero_grad();loss.backward();opt.step()
if loss.item()+1e-6<best:
        best=loss.item();wait=0
torch.save({'e':epoch,'loss':best,'model':net.state_dict()},'ckpt/best.pt')
else:
        wait+=1
if wait>=patience:
            torch.save({'e':epoch,'loss':loss.item(),'model':net.state_dict()},f'ckpt/plateau_e{epoch:02d}.pt')
wait=0
print('done')

import torch,torch.nn as nn,torch.nn.functional as F
class DSConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,cin,cout,k=3):super().__init__();self.dw=nn.Conv2d(cin,cin,k,groups=cin,padding=k//2);self.pw=nn.Conv2d(cin,cout,1)
def forward(self,x):return self.pw(F.relu(self.dw(x)))
def energy_dw(cin,H,W,k):return 2*H*W*cin*k*k
def energy_pw(cin,cout,H,W):return 2*H*W*cin*cout
def prune_pw_out_energy(pw:nn.Conv2d,keep_ratio,H,W):
    with torch.no_grad():
        e=energy_pw(pw.in_channels,pw.out_channels,H,W)
imp=pw.weight.detach().abs().view(pw.out_channels,-1).mean(1)
score=imp/(e+1e-9);k=max(1,int(keep_ratio*pw.out_channels))
keep=torch.topk(score,k).indices
pw.weight=nn.Parameter(pw.weight[keep].clone())
if pw.bias is not None:pw.bias=nn.Parameter(pw.bias[keep].clone())
pw.out_channels=k
net=DSConv(24,64)
prune_pw_out_energy(net.pw,0.6,56,56)
x=torch.randn(1,24,56,56);y=net(x);print(y.shape,net.pw.out_channels)

import torch,torch.nn as nn,torch.nn.functional as F
class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,d=96,h=6,ffn=192):
        super().__init__();self.h=h;self.dk=d//h
self.qkv=nn.Linear(d,3*d);self.o=nn.Linear(d,d)
self.fc1=nn.Linear(d,ffn);self.fc2=nn.Linear(ffn,d)
def forward(self,x):
        B,T,D=x.shape
qkv=self.qkv(x);q,k,v=qkv.chunk(3,dim=-1)
q=q.view(B,T,self.h,self.dk).transpose(1,2);k=k.view(B,T,self.h,self.dk).transpose(1,2);v=v.view(B,T,self.h,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
a=(q@k.transpose(-2,-1))/self.dk**0.5;p=a.softmax(-1);o=(p@v).transpose(1,2).reshape(B,T,-1)
x=self.o(o)+x
return self.fc2(F.gelu(self.fc1(x)))
def head_energy(T,dk):return T*T*dk+T*T+T*dk
def prune_heads_energy(o:nn.Linear,h,dk,keep_ratio,T):
    with torch.no_grad():
        H=h;D=H*dk;W=o.weight.detach()
blocks=W[:,:D].view(W.size(0),H,dk)
imp=blocks.abs().mean(dim=(0,2))
e=torch.full_like(imp,float(head_energy(T,dk)))
score=imp/(e+1e-9);k=max(1,int(keep_ratio*H))
keep=torch.topk(score,k).indices.tolist()
new_in=dk*k
o.weight=nn.Parameter(W[:,:new_in].clone())
if o.bias is not None:o.bias=nn.Parameter(o.bias.clone())
return k
def prune_ffn_energy(fc1:nn.Linear,keep_ratio,tokens):
    with torch.no_grad():
        imp=fc1 .weight.detach().abs().mean(1)
e=fc1 .in_features+tokens
k=max(1,int(keep_ratio*fc1 .out_features))
keep=torch.topk(imp/(e+1e-9),k).indices
fc1 .weight=nn.Parameter(fc1 .weight[keep].clone())
if fc1 .bias is not None:fc1 .bias=nn.Parameter(fc1 .bias[keep].clone())
fc1 .out_features=k
blk=Block()
new_h=prune_heads_energy(blk.o,blk.h,blk.dk,0.5,T=64)
prune_ffn_energy(blk.fc1,0.6,tokens=4096)
x=torch.randn(2,64,96);print(blk(x).shape,'heads',new_h,'ffn',blk.fc1 .out_features)

class MLP(nn.Module):

class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,d=96,h=6,ffn=192):
        super().__init__();self.h=h;self.dk=d//h
self.qkv=nn.Linear(d,3*d);self.o=nn.Linear(d,d)
self.fc1=nn.Linear(d,ffn);self.fc2=nn.Linear(ffn,d)
def forward(self,x):
        B,T,D=x.shape
qkv=self.qkv(x);q,k,v=qkv.chunk(3,dim=-1)
q=q.view(B,T,self.h,self.dk).transpose(1,2);k=k.view(B,T,self.h,self.dk).transpose(1,2);v=v.view(B,T,self.h,self.dk).transpose(1,2)
a=(q@k.transpose(-2,-1))/self.dk**0.5;p=a.softmax(-1);o=(p@v).transpose(1,2).reshape(B,T,-1)
x=self.o(o)+x
return self.fc2(F.gelu(self.fc1(x)))
def head_energy(T,dk):return T*T*dk+T*T+T*dk
def prune_heads_energy(o:nn.Linear,h,dk,keep_ratio,T):
    with torch.no_grad():
        H=h;D=H*dk;W=o.weight.detach()

a=(q@k.transpose(-2,-1))/self.dk**0.5;p=a.softmax(-1);o=(p@v).transpose(1,2).reshape(B,T,-1)
x=self.o(o)+x

        while j>0 and ch!=p[j]:j=lps[j-1]
if ch==p[j]:j+=1
if j==len(p):res.append(i-j+1);j=lps[j-1]
return res

class DSU:
    def __init__(self,n):self.p=list(range(n));self.r=[0]*n
def find(self,x):
        while self.p[x]!=x:
            self.p[x]=self.p[self.p[x]];x=self.p[x]
return x
def union(self,a,b):
        ra,rb=self.find(a),self.find(b)
if ra==rb:return False
if self.r[ra]<self.r[rb]:ra,rb=rb,ra
self.p[rb]=ra
if self.r[ra]==self.r[rb]:self.r[ra]+=1
return True
ds=DSU(1000);[ds.union(i,(i*3+1)%1000)for i in range(1000)]
